content:
We are excited to announce Aristotle Agent, the most advanced formal reasoning agent, is now live across both web, CLI, and API!

If you've used Aristotle in the past, you can expect the following upgrades with this release:

  • First in Formal Math: We’re the best formal math model according to ProofBench, by vals.aI, ahead of the closest competitor by 15%. Aristotle Agent can autonomously prove/formalize for up to 24 hrs without human intervention.
  • Fully Agentic: Give it an English problem and it will prove/formalize from scratch, or it can work and edit files directly inside your Lean project / repository.
  • Improved Code Quality: Aristotle agent produces repo-quality code; project leads are increasingly merging Aristotle-drafted PRs with no modifications.

Aristotle also now runs on Lean v4.28!

Check it out at https://aristotle.harmonic.fun and let us know what you think!
